paragraphs.source_en: Though her mother and aunt were outwardly cordial while inwardly estranged, each eager to outdo the other, Princess Sen harbored no such thoughts. If the poised, dignified, innocent, and lovable Princess Sen should before long bear Hideyori a son, that child would no longer be merely Hideyori’s son, nor Lady Yodo’s grandson alone—Sen would surely bring about the day when he belonged to them all.
